Name: Undead Regeneration
Components: V, M (the freshly severed head of a Medium sized Beast, which the spell consumes)
Description: You reinforce the magic that keeps an undead animated. Up to six undead creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 3rd.
